question.text: Kavita receives total IDCW of Rs.18,000 from two schemes of the same AMC during a financial year. She is a resident with PAN. What is the TDS amount?

answer.text: Nil, as the amount is below Rs.50,000

explanation.text: The Logic: TDS on IDCW for resident investors is 10%. Dividend income below Rs.5,000 in a financial year is exempt from TDS, but once the threshold is crossed, TDS applies on the IDCW paid. 10% of Rs.18,000 = Rs.1,800. The Trap: The common error is treating the Rs.5,000 figure as a slab-style exemption and computing TDS only on the amount exceeding Rs.5,000. Note: The 10% rate assumes a resident investor with PAN on record. Without PAN, the rate moves up to 20%.
